Approving a pull request with required reviews (added during P01 rework; quote: 'Pull request authors cannot approve their own pull requests.')

REST API endpoints for pull requests (added during P01 review round 1: 'Merge a pull request' PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/merge and 'Merge a pull request asynchronously' PUT .../merge-async; required permissions are listed in S-gh-fgpat under Contents write: merge, merge-async and POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/merges, with no additional permission)

Deployments and environments (added during P01 internal check 6; quotes: 'The deployment branch or tag rule is matched against the GITHUB_REF of the workflow run'; 'Secrets stored in an environment are only available to workflow jobs that reference the environment'; 'Allowing administrators to bypass protection rules is only available for public repositories for users on GitHub Free, GitHub Pro, and GitHub Team plans'; deployment branches and tags are available for all public repositories, and for private repositories on GitHub Pro or GitHub Team)

REST API endpoints for GitHub Apps (added during P01 internal check 6; 'Get a repository installation for the authenticated app' GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/installation, JWT required; the installation response schema has a required 'permissions' field)

GraphQL reference, pull requests (added during P01 internal check 6; mutations 'mergePullRequest' ('Merge a pull request.') and 'enablePullRequestAutoMerge' ('Enable the default auto-merge on a pull request.'); required fine-grained/App permissions not stated there)

About organization teams (added during P01 internal check 6; quotes: 'Organization owners and team maintainers can give teams admin, read, or write access to organization repositories'; 'Child teams inherit the parent's access permissions')

REST API endpoints for team members and teams (added during P01 internal check 6; 'List team members' GET /orgs/{org}/teams/{team_slug}/members: 'Team members will include the members of child teams' with an inherited flag; 'List child teams' GET /orgs/{org}/teams/{team_slug}/teams, documented at https://docs.github.com/en/rest/teams/teams)

Script injections (added during P01 internal check 7; quotes: 'You should ensure that these values do not flow directly into workflows, actions, API calls, or anywhere else where they could be interpreted as executable code'; 'Before the shell script is run, the expressions inside ${{ }} are evaluated and then substituted with the resulting values, which can make it vulnerable to shell command injection')

Contexts reference (added during P01 internal check 7; quotes: github.triggering_actor 'The username of the user that initiated the workflow run'; github.actor 'Any workflow re-runs will use the privileges of github.actor, even if the actor initiating the re-run (github.triggering_actor) has different privileges'; github.run_attempt 'begins at 1 for the workflow run's first attempt, and increments with each re-run'; inputs 'Contains the inputs of a reusable or manually triggered workflow')

permissions.notes: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}; GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rules/branches/{branch}; GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets.
Write covers POST git/blobs, git/trees, git/commits, POST/PATCH git/refs, and PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/merge. Repository-wide; no branch dimension.
Listed as additional permission for PUT contents/{path}, POST/PATCH git/refs when workflow files change. Only 'write' level exists.
POST issues, PATCH issues, POST issue comments, POST milestones, GET assignees. Comments/milestones also accept Pull requests (Additional Permissions marked).
POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls.
POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/statuses/{sha}.
Documented gap: 'Using fine-grained personal access token to call the Checks API'. No Checks section exists in S-gh-fgpat.
Repository permission table.
POST/PUT/DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets require write. Reading rulesets uses Metadata read.

Organization permission; 'Organization permissions can only be used if the resource owner is an organization'. REST /orgs/{org}/projectsV2 items/fields/views listed in S-gh-fgpat. GraphQL mutation level requirements not tabulated.
Documented gap: 'Using fine-grained personal access token to access Projects owned by a user account'.
Repository permission.
Also required for HTTPS Git with x-access-token (S-gh-app-auth-inst) and for createProjectV2 with repositoryId (S-gh-projects-api).
Repository permission section 'Workflows'.
Create check runs: 'To create a check run, you must use a GitHub App' (S-gh-rest-checks).
Repository permission section 'Administration'.

Organization permission section 'Projects'; 'You must give permission to read and write organization projects; permission to read and write repository projects will not be sufficient' (S-gh-projects-actions). Levels taken from S-gh-pat-manage parameter table for organization_projects; App UI levels not separately confirmed.
No user-owned Projects permission in App 'User permissions' sections (searched S-gh-appperms, S-gh-app-choose). Unverified.
'Grants full access to public and private repositories'. Applies to all repositories the user can access (S-gh-pat-manage).
'Grants the ability to add and update GitHub Actions workflow files.'
Status access without code access.
Read only; 'OAuth apps and authenticated users can view check runs ... but they are not able to create them'.
'Grants read/write access to user and organization projects.' read:project for read only.
Only documented credential path for user-owned Projects. repo also 'grants the ability to manage projects owned by users'.
gh project: 'The minimum required scope for the token is: project'; add via gh auth refresh -s project. gh login minimum scopes repo, read:org, gist (S-gh-cli-auth-login).
Same scope for user Projects.
gh minimum scopes: repo, read:org, gist; cannot be removed (S-gh-cli-auth-refresh).
Actions permissions key; repository of the workflow only (S-gh-actions-token).
Repository setting can block creating/approving PRs (S-gh-actions-repo-settings).
'GITHUB_TOKEN is scoped to the repository level and cannot access projects.'
Same.
No administration key in documented permissions list.
No workflows key in documented permissions list; behaviour when pushing workflow changes unverified.

create/list Project, link to repo, create fields, set Status options (GraphQL updateProjectV2Field), add items, set Todo

needs.status: documented for Apps; applies only if Project is created with repositoryId

needs.why: create state-branch, agent/** and main rulesets
needs.enforcement: actor must have repository admin or 'edit repository rules' role (S-gh-rules-about); rulesets need public repo or Pro/Team/Enterprise for private

must_not_have: setup credential reused as runtime credential
setup credential inside any model sandbox

roles.holder: enrolled trusted supervisor host, outside sandboxes

needs.why: conditional commit to harness/state; publish agent/* candidates
needs.enforcement: ruleset A on harness/state and agent/**/*: restrict deletions + block force pushes (non_fast_forward), empty bypass; ruleset B: restrict creations/updates, bypass = supervisor App (actor_type Integration) only. main ruleset must not list this identity as bypass.

needs.why: post issue comments/projections; read human commands

credential_types: org-owned: github_app_installation (Projects) or fine_grained_pat (organization_projects); user-owned: classic_pat or oauth_gh_cli (project) only

needs.why: optional: open integration PR for human

must_not_have: pull_requests write if PR approvals by the App could count toward required reviews (unverified)

roles.holder: GitHub Actions job (GITHUB_TOKEN) plus App installation token minted in-job

needs.why: conditional state commit and candidate publication
needs.enforcement: state-branch bypass must name the publisher; GITHUB_TOKEN as bypass actor not found -> prefer in-job App installation token

must_not_have: scheduled runs as authority for claims/renewals
workflow edits without review (anyone with write can change permissions key)

roles.read_access: none required; supervisor supplies exact checkout. Public repos are readable anonymously; private repo read tokens would be exposed to the model.
must_not_have: Docker Sandboxes 'github' secret service (proxy injects host token into api.github.com/github.com requests)

roles.read_access: none required; supervisor supplies exact candidate SHA checkout.

roles.holder: dedicated CI GitHub App or Actions workflow identity, separate from publisher

needs.enforcement: ruleset required_status_checks with integration_id pinned to the CI App (S-gh-rest-rules); app must be installed with statuses:write and have recently submitted a check run (S-gh-rules-available)
statuses from 'any source' can be set by any writer; pin source App

must_not_have: contents write on harness/state or main

roles.holder: human GitHub account (write/maintain role), own credentials, never in sandboxes

needs.enforcement: main ruleset: require pull request with >=1 approval, required status checks from trusted-CI App, block force pushes, restrict deletions; minimal bypass list; avoid bypass_mode exempt (no audit entry, S-gh-rest-rules)

must_not_have: ruleset bypass unless explicitly accepted as visible override

atomic across refs; beforeOid must match; zero OID asserts ref must not exist
updates only if remote ref equals expect; empty expect = must not exist; only explicit form is non-experimental; --atomic all-or-nothing if server supports
